## Five stages. Four are ours.

Audio goes in on the left and comes back as a voice on the right. Everything except the language model is our own CPU model.

- Psst Noise suppression

- Turno Turn-taking

About 0.9 s to the first word of the reply on one 4-vCPU node · See where the time goes →

## Turno decides whose turn it is.

The turn passes on what it hears, not on a silence timer. A “mhm” doesn’t take it. A real interruption does.

## Psst hears the voice, not the room.

The same two seconds of speech, drawn from the real audio. Drag the line to compare, or press play and watch it move.

## Same models. Three places.

Because nothing needs an accelerator, the pipeline goes wherever the CPU is.
